messages:
kai: Quick idea — add a routing-preview API that computes effective route/quota outcomes for a proposed config without applying it. Console would show simulated traffic split and quota impacts.
ashley: yes please. current console preview is just a config diff, not what actually routes. this would help ops + SRE.
sam: big +1. main risk is we accidentally diverge preview logic from real router logic and then previews lie. need single code path.
nora: agree. can we do it as a 'dry-run' mode inside the router service? i.e. accept config + sample of tenant traffic shape and return simulated metrics.
kai: idea: expose POST /v1/config_preview with body {config, sample_profile:set} -> returns {route_breakdown, quota_usage_estimate, anomalies}. keep it internal first.
sam: how do we generate sample_profile? real traffic shape varies by tenant. maybe allow presets + ability to upload a small histogram.
nora: presets are good (low/med/high seq len, burstiness). also allow "replay-key" to replay N real requests in staging.
ashley: UX asks: console should show: before/after route %s, expected latency band, token cost delta, any quota spikes flagged. flag diff if preview shows >5% tenant reroute.
kai: telemetry gating: only surface preview results if preview-run succeeded and matched router behavior in last 24h on a canary dataset. keep a checksum to detect divergence.
sam: checksum lgtm. but how do we compute parity? run the same config through both preview path and real router in sim mode and compare outputs. put mismatch into an alert.
nora: edgecases: samples with long KV cache warmup will mispredict latency. add a warmup model and annotate uncertainty.
kai: implementation sketch: add PreviewEngine class in router, reuse same rule-evaluator + quota-simulator. expose a lightweight proto for results.
ashley: question on API contract: should preview be idempotent and return an etag? we might want to cache results for repeated previews to avoid cost.
sam: return a preview_id + checksum. if client resubmits same config+sample, return cached result. keep cache TTL short (~1h).
kai: security: only internal tokens for now. later expose to console with RBAC. also rate limit previews per team.
nora: ops concern: compute cost. plan to run preview runs async and stream results back. for small configs run inline, big ones queue.
ashley: console UX: add "run preview with sample" button + option "use live staging traffic". show a confidence score and raw simulated histogram link.
sam: include a small curl example in docs: 
```
curl -X POST https://router.internal/v1/config_preview \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL' \\n  -d '{"config": <json>, "sample_profile": "high-burst"}'
```

nora: tests: unit for evaluator, integration that compares preview vs real router on a fixed story set, and a nightly parity job that checks checksums across services.
kai: rollout plan: start in staging, run shadow-preview for every config change for 48h, then enable console button for a subset of teams (cohorts).
ashley: cohort selection: pick teams that opt-in + 10 internal tenants. implement cohort via tenant hash with salt so shift is deterministic.
sam: watch metrics: preview_match_rate, preview_duration_p95, preview_cost_estimate_tokens. create alerts at preview_match_rate < 99.5%.
kai: open questions: do previews simulate quota throttles exactly? we probably should model throttles but mark them as best-effort.
nora: action items: kai open PR with PreviewEngine outline; sam add telemetry metrics to SLA board; ashley mockup console button & confidence UI; nora write parity job doc. everyone ack?
ashley: ack
sam: ack
kai: ack
nora: ack
deploy-bot: Preview service staged deploy started on infra-staging (build 2026.03.22-77) :rocket:
